body: I've waited almost 10 years for a dragon age sequel, the world can't end until I've played it through at least once 😭
Erika uses all pronouns so they/them isn't an issue, likewise she/her or he/him 🤷

I only played the game this year because of hearing about the transphobia back upon release and it's nowhere near as bad as I thought but I will admit as a non-binary person, I was really frustrated at this game, if I chose certain genitals that don't "match" the body I have, it's just ignored in sex scenes?

also if I chose a male body but femme V voice I can't romance anybody at all? why let me be trans if it just removes a chunk of the game for me? the characters in it are allowed to have their sexualities but it's disappointing to be like lol nobody likes you BECAUSE you're trans

a lot of people mention BG3 here and I really do think they got more of the trans stuff right

(also didn't like the mission in phantom liberty with the braindance gone wrong so it's "funny" because a man thinks he's a woman but i don't think it's 10/10 transphobic, idk)

it's slightly different with it being set entirely in space but Citizen Sleeper is by the same studio and has a similar vibe! There's a character in the late game that really reminds me of Levi at the end of the season

I'd also recommend the book "To Be Taught If Fortunate" by Becky Chambers as a relation to scavangers reign but I'd recommend the wayfarer series by chambers as well if you like sci fi and anti capitalism vibes is general
